mode_length_rule: Per-image maximum observed predicted length; absent positions vote None, not filled from labels.
rank1_interpretation: Exact kernel has accuracy interpretation only under diverse independent errors. Char/edit estimates are similarity factors; their accuracy MAE is a model-mismatch diagnostic.
cross_run: Historical Model1-A versus v3 Model1-B; not matched-generator independent seeds.
optional_collision_term: Not fitted; c and accuracy are additionally non-identifiable without anchors.
automatic_k: Smallest passing k; if none pass, report k5 fallback explicitly, not a successful band detection.
rank2_flag: In-sample additional structure, not proof of wrongness; components not identified as truth/trap.
